CITY OF ALHAMBRA PLANNING COMMISSION
  ACTION MINUTES

  Regular Meeting
  April 3, 2023

A.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER: 7:00 P.M. in the Council Chambers of Alhambra City Hall,
  and via video conference and teleconference.

B.  ROLL CALL:

  Present:  Grijalva, Ho, Juarez, Mojarro, Olson, Tsujii, Garcia, Gardea

  Commissioner Pham arrived at 7:02 P.M.

  Absent:  Wang

  Staff Present: Vanessa Reynoso, Deputy Director; Paul Lam, Principal Planner; Maia
  McCurley, Senior Planner; Megan Wu, Associate Planner; Erica Vega,
  Deputy City Attorney

C.  FLAG SALUTE:  Led by President Gardea

D.  ELECTION OF OFFICERS FOR 2023-2024:

  Nomination and election of President, Vice President, and Secretary of the Planning Commission
  for 2023-2024, in accordance with AMC 2.24.050.

  MOTION:
  x  Moved to elect the Director of Community Development as Secretary of
  the Planning Commission.
  x  Moved by Commissioner Olson, Seconded by Commissioner Ho.
  x  The motion carried by a Voice Vote with a majority of the Commission
  voting in favor of the motion.

  MOTION:
  x  Moved to elect Eric Garcia as Vice President of the Planning
  Commission.
  x  Moved by Commissioner Olson, Seconded by President Gardea.
  x  The motion carried by a Voice Vote with a majority of the Commission
  voting in favor of the motion.

  MOTION:
  x  Moved to elect Noya Wang as President of the Planning Commission.
  x  Moved by President Gardea, Seconded by Commissioner Olson.

G.  PUBLIC HEARINGS:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 5:  LOT MERGER LOTM-22-01 (7:10 P.M.)
  x 726 East Main Street, 17 South Cordova Street, and 21 South
  Cordova Street
  x Request: This is an application for a Lot Merger LOTM-22-01 to
  combine three (3) contiguous parcels into one (1) parcel in order to
  accommodate the previously approved Chinatown Service Center
  project located at 726 East Main Street, 17 South Cordova Street, and
  21 South Cordova Street in the EMC (East Main Commercial) and R-
  1 (Single-Family Residential) zones.
  x Recommended Action: Adopt Resolution 23-06 approving Lot
  Merger LOTM-22-01 subject to the Conditions of Approval, and
  finding LOTM-22-01 to be exempt from review under the California
  Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) pursuant to Section 15305, Class
  5 of Title 14 of the California Code of Regulations, which exempts
  from CEQA review projects that consist of minor alterations in land
  use limitations.
  x Associate Planner Megan Wu provided the Staff presentation.
  3
  04/03/2023
   x  Peter Ng and Anthony Tam, Chief Executive Officer of Chinatown
  Service Center and applicant, respectively, were available to answer
  questions.
  x  The public hearing was opened and then closed.
  x  Public Comments:
  1.) Jennifer Ng
  2.) Lewis McCammon
  3.) Olga Alarid
  4.) Melissa Michelson

  MOTION:
  x  Moved to approve.
